aggregation.weighting: equal weight per unique training configuration/seed/checkpoint; tasks use their available configurations
aggregation.coverage: available-case, not a balanced or paired panel; record counts and seed coverage may differ by checkpoint and task
aggregation.dedup_identity: model plus all non-null args except the explicitly excluded operational/task-panel fields, then checkpoint epoch
aggregation.duplicate_policy: union agreeing probe fields and task panels; conflicting measurements fail; source paths counted once
aggregation.legacy_policy: normalize single-task schema; merge saved strings before hidden48 cropping; unresolved variable-length endpoints fail
aggregation.independence: record evaluations reuse canaries across seeds/checkpoints and are not independent trials
